hook_text: Your breakfast came from a field, a tree, a cow or a hen. Can you tell which?
clip_script: A school market in Bloemfontein. Maize meal, bread, apples, beans, spinach: all from plants. Milk, eggs, chicken, fish, honey: all from animals. Peanut butter? Plants. Cheese? Animals, because it is made from milk. Sorting food into plant foods and animal foods is called classifying. Look at your plate tonight: how much came from a plant, and how much from an animal?
visual_style: Whiteboard table split down the middle, food items sliding left to a plant symbol or right to an animal symbol, with a few tricky ones wobbling before they decide.
mood: Fun and fast, like a sorting game.
pacing: One food at a time, quick sort, slow down for the tricky ones.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort everything you eat in one day into plant and animal foods.
